Keep the composition, two large panels, spacing, literal text, menu order, PNG jagged sculpted green-blue headings and orange-gold action font exactly recognizable. Keep the purple 3D crystal and empty gem, medal and trophy sockets; no characters or new gameplay icons. Text remains the focus cue only: no arrows, selection bars or boxed menu buttons.

No Crash logo, no copied game characters, no additional labels, no heavy foliage, no huge illustrated props, no UI restructuring, no changes to the excellent font.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer, production game UI raster asset. Reference image is STYLE ONLY. Generate ONE perfectly front-facing SQUARE empty menu panel from its midnight blue painted stone and chipped brass material. This will be a nine-slice UI texture. CRITICAL: panel outer rectangular edges exactly coincide with all four canvas edges (no margin or padding), chamfer only the outermost 2% corners. The whole panel is opaque except the tiny cut-off corner triangles outside the chamfer, which are transparent. All decorative border detail is confined to the outermost 9% of the square: small angled warm-brass corner caps with one tiny dark rivet each, hairline warm gold edge, thin cyan stone bevel underneath, a few fine hand-painted edge chips. The inner 82% is an EMPTY evenly dark midnight petrol/navy surface with very fine broad diagonal painted stone grain; quiet and uniform, no strong gradients, no internal borders, no cracks extending more than 9% into panel. No text, lettering, numbers, symbols, gems, sockets, lights, divider lines, glow effects, shadows outside the panel, or background. Crisp AAA Crash 4-inspired cartoon game materials. Precisely square 1:1 orthographic isolated asset, no perspective. Thin refined frame, not ornate. This is NOT a menu screenshot, entirely blank usable panel.
